about.title: About.exe — Adam OS
about.name: Khoumari Adam
about.role: Embedded Systems Engineer x AI Vibe Coder
about.p1: I build hardware that thinks and software that feels alive. Currently powering through my Master 1 in Embedded Systems at Bouira University (graduating in 2027). During 2025-2026, I had the honor of leading the Scientific Club Afaq as president, hosting tech workshops and hackathons for hundreds of students.
about.p2: My weekends usually involve teaching robotics and Arduino to curious kids at CLS Bouira, configuring 24/7 home-lab Raspberry Pi AI agents, or tuning ESP32 motor drivers for miniature Rocket League soccer cars. If I'm not soldering a sensor array, I'm probably rewatching Spider-Man.
about.p3: I believe in clean code, tactile retro interfaces, and building real tools that solve actual problems without fluff. Take a look around my OS!

projects.title: Projects.exe
projects.p1_desc: ESP32 sensors + Machine Learning predicting soil moisture and crop watering needs.
projects.p1_details: I built an automated closed-loop irrigation system using capacitive soil moisture, humidity, and temperature sensors wired to an ESP32 microcontroller. The data syncs to Firebase while an ML model classifies plant species and calculates precise watering schedules, saving 35% water usage.
projects.p2_desc: Taught 20+ beginners to build, program, & race autonomous cars in a 4-day intensive workshop.
projects.p2_details: Designed and taught a 4-day hands-on robotics bootcamp at CLS Bouira. Guided participants from zero knowledge to assembling motor driver circuits, tuning line-following PID loops, and competing in a live 2v2 Rocket League soccer tournament with customized RC cars.
projects.p3_desc: Self-hosted headless Linux VPS running autonomous AI agents 24/7 with zero cloud fees.
projects.p3_details: Configured a home-lab server on a Raspberry Pi running headless Debian Linux. Handles 24/7 background cron tasks, automated code repository indexing, web scraping pipelines, and local LLM orchestration without relying on paid cloud APIs.
projects.p4_desc: Autonomous multi-agent dev team: architect, builder, debugger, tester, & copy reviewer.
projects.p4_details: Created an agentic workflow that mimics a full engineering department. Roles are strictly partitioned into architectural planning, code execution, automated unit test generation, and strict anti-slop copy auditing to deliver clean software fast.
projects.p5_desc: Full private school ERP handling tuition, receipts, schedules, rosters, & financial reports.
projects.p5_details: Engineered a production-grade management platform for private educational institutions in 2 months. Features instant receipt printing, tuition tracking, interactive timetable planning, class rosters, and automated monthly income/expense balance sheets.
